About

Application development with AI and machine learning at the centre.

I am an Application Developer with a B.E. in Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning, targeting AI/ML and software engineering roles.

My work sits in three places: deep learning and computer vision for image-based prediction, Python and Streamlit for turning a model into something a person can actually use, and workflow automation for the plumbing between tools. My final-year project — an AI vision system that identifies crop damage from field images for PMFBY insurance claims — runs through all three.

At Findiag Innovation Limited (Bizvitals) I work as an Application Developer & QA Tester. Day to day that means manual testing of the web application, validating features and user flows, reporting bugs and verifying behaviour across edge cases — plus designing the product's signup flow, executive analytics dashboards and multi-page financial report in Figma.

I am building depth in Google Cloud Platform, and I only list what I can explain in an interview.
